Raksha Bandhan Giveaway Reel

Aug 2026 · Engagement campaign

A UGC "tag your sibling" giveaway mechanic, benchmarked against the account's own 18-reel baseline — not industry averages.

Result vs. baseline — each ring is this metric's share of (metric + baseline)

47×

2.5×

Headline proof point

This single reel generated 143 shares — equal to the combined shares of the previous 18 reels on the account. Shares outpaced likes, a pattern that signals person-to-person DM sharing rather than passive engagement.

  • Diagnosis: DM shares land in private inboxes and don't feed Instagram's public distribution signal — explaining the 7.5× engagement lift without wider reach.
  • Flagged and filtered a 5-handle reciprocal-comment-like cluster (65% of comment likes) before public judging to protect entry integrity.

Freedom Day Teaser

15 Aug 2026 · Reach & awareness campaign

A culturally-timed "coming soon" teaser using an original web-slinging superhero character (custom IP) to tease the air-fryer lineup without revealing it.

Result vs. baseline — each ring is this metric's share of (metric + baseline)

Headline proof point

Achieved the account's highest single-post reach in the analyzed window — roughly 7× a normal reel — while running near-zero engagement: a clean, top-of-funnel, pure-reach result.

  • Paired with the Rakhi reel, the two campaigns bracket the funnel cleanly: a reach specialist and an engagement specialist, proving the ability to design deliberately for different funnel stages.

YouTube Shorts — Retention & Hook Analysis

Rolling analysis · Structured Excel workbook

Diagnosing which Shorts drove channel growth, to isolate the single lever separating high performers from the rest.

Headline proof point

One Short ("Never missed a chance to say butter chicken") drove over 98% of total Shorts views in the window, with 71.74% retention — versus 35–45% on newer uploads.

  • Conclusion: hook quality in the first 1–2 seconds — not topic, length or posting time — is the primary retention driver, now the top recommended rule for future Shorts production.

6-Month Instagram Audit → 30-Day Strategy

Feb–Jul 2026 · ~90 posts · 78,660 followers

A full-account audit to find what actually drives reach and follows, diagnose the funnel bottleneck, and turn the findings into an executable 30-day content calendar.

The funnel bottleneck

33 link taps— out of 1.39M monthly views (0.002% — slice exaggerated here so it's visible)
1.39M views— reached the profile but never tapped through, the real bottleneck
  • Problem-moment content dramatically outperforms product content: a single post about a Bengaluru LPG shortage pulled 31,039 reach and 48 follows — versus near-zero follows on standard product carousels.
  • Reels drive reach; feed images drive follows — every trackable follow in six months came from a feed post, not a reel.
  • Carousels underperformed as a format: recipe-list carousels averaged ~2,200 reach with near-zero saves despite being designed for saves.
  • A steep, unexplained reach collapse around 3 August flagged as an account/link-level issue requiring diagnosis before any content fix would work.
Strategy delivered

A full 30-day, three-tier content calendar, replacing bio-link CTAs with a DM-keyword mechanic, on a repeatable weekly cadence of 3 reels + 1 optional carousel — delivered as a branded, swipeable HTML strategy deck.

The 30-day calendar, by tier

13 Reach— top-of-funnel discovery posts
8 Proof— credibility & social-proof posts
9 Intent— conversion-stage posts
